defects.title: Global categorical filters are single-select
defects.note: In progress on PR #50 and Integration: Calendar bulk staffing, LiveReportImageGallery, Data Quality severity/source, and Payroll Rate Manager role/scope filters use shared multi-select behavior with backend filtering and bounded pagination. Payroll API supports repeated role/scope values while retaining legacy single-value callers. Focused multi-select, Payroll API/client, large pagination, and Data Quality tests passed 28/28 on both branches; consolidated scope remains OPEN.

defects.title: Imported Excel staffing display inconsistent across Shift surfaces
defects.note: Existing shared resolver is used across Calendar and Shift surfaces; 66 focused resolver, display, identity, and runtime tests passed on PR #50. Staging/Production rollout remains unverified.

defects.title: Admin self operational_roles false-success
defects.note: Existing allowlisted self-update persists through the authoritative RPC, rejects null/error results before success feedback, and refreshes current-user state; 12 focused tests passed on PR #50. Staging/Production rollout remains unverified.
